_comment: Porter MCP server for Neovim AI plugins (avante.nvim + codecompanion.nvim) via mcphub.nvim. HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcpServers.porter block into ~/.config/mcphub/servers.json (requires mcphub.nvim installed; one config covers both plugins). Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token, then :MCPHub refresh or restart Neovim. UNVERIFIED: not tested against a live Neovim install here.
